clauses.clause: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse {1}{G} Legendary Creature — Human Druid 1/2 (cast)
clauses.evidence: [cast]: hand -> stack -> battlefield, P/T 1/2, mana C-1 G-1.

clauses.clause: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 green Cat creature token.
clauses.evidence: 'you draw two cards, one after the other': "card's triggered ability [0] triggers", 'you:Cat moves new -> battlefield', 2/2 (the token's colors are ('G',), inspected in J06_1's final state); 'you draw a card' and 'the opponent draws a card': none. Packs J06_1 (two draws, one Cat), J06_2 (three draws: still one), J06_3 (a card in turn 1 and the draw step of turn 3 are no second card), J06_4 (second card of a later turn), J06_5 (the opponent's two draws). Pack J06_10 (the opponent's turn counts as a turn). Pack J06_11 (the first card of the turn was drawn before Jolrael entered: it still counts).

clauses.clause: {4}{G}{G}: Until end of turn, creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
clauses.evidence: [activate [1]]: paid C-4 G-2; hand 6 -> card, you_bear, you_giant all 6/6 (mine only), back 'after the turn ends'. Packs J06_6 (my hand, not theirs; base P/T under a +1/+1 counter; the opponent's creature untouched), J06_7 (X fixed when the ability resolves, a creature entering later is not affected), J06_8 (ends at end of turn), J06_9 (cost {4}{G}{G}).
